messages:
Sam H: quick ping on PR #438 — Priya left a couple style nits (naming + formatting). I pushed one small change but CI ruff is still failing. can someone take a look?
Priya K: saw the push — thanks. main nit is `routing_table` -> `route_table` in src/inference/routing.py (PEP8 naming + avoids confusion with the RouteTable class). also a couple line-length issues in the docstring.
Jordan C: I can pick the rename. fyi we should run `ruff fix` and `black` before pushing.
Sam H: ok thanks. quick question: do we prefer a separate commit for rename or amend the existing commit? want to avoid forcing everyone to rebase if possible.
Priya K: separate small commit is fine — keeps history clear and avoids altering the PR's existing reviews. mark the conversations resolved after commit.
LintBot: automated: ruff 0.12.1 found 3 issues in 2 files. Suggested fixes available with `ruff check --fix src/`.
Jordan C: pushing fix in a sec. commands I used:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/pr-438-style
python -m ruff check --fix src/inference/routing.py
black src/inference/routing.py
git add src/inference/routing.py
git commit -m "style: rename routing_table -> route_table; autofix formatting"
git push origin fix/pr-438-style
```
Sam H: ^ thanks — will wait for CI. also can you include a one-line note in the PR description about the rename so QA doesn't get confused?
Jordan C: added the note. CI shows one flaky test unrelated to this change, but lint stage passed.
Priya K: re-reviewing now. the rename looks good, docstring wrap fixed. approving once CI green on integration tests. :+1:
Sam H: do we want to merge once we have 1 approval and CI green, or wait for 2 approvals?
Priya K: this repo policy is 1 approver for non-security, non-api changes. we're good.
Jordan C: merging now.
Sam H: thanks — and thanks for keeping it separate, made the diff easy to follow. :tada:
LintBot: automated: merged PR #438 (fix/pr-438-style) into main by Jordan C at 1712523775.
Sam H: closing thread, marking resolved.
